response.title: Reefer plug-in charges at Hosur | Kestrel Logistics Help Center

question.answer: A reefer plug‑in at the Hosur yard costs 2,450 INR per container per day [1].
The penalty for a late gate-in after the cut-off is 9,800 INR per box [1].
